content: The HWPX update task was successfully completed with a reward of 1.0. The strategy of using `xml.etree.ElementTree` with pre-registered namespaces for XML manipulation and `zipfile` for repackaging is confirmed effective for HWPX (Hancom Office) document modification. Key success factors include: 1) Detecting and registering all namespaces from the original XML to prevent prefix mangling. 2) Identifying specific text-bearing tags (e.g., `{...}t`) for targeted string replacement. 3) Removing layout cache elements (e.g., `lineSegArray`) from modified paragraphs to force the word processor to re-render the text. 4) Ensuring the `mimetype` file remains uncompressed and at the start of the ZIP archive if required by the format.
